SELECT p.id, p.bill_no, p.sign_no, p.veh_code, p.node_no, p.site_id, p.site_no, p.should_count, p.done_count, p.lack_count, p.content, p.status, p.del_flag, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, e.site_name, e.site_type, e.road_name, COUNT(*) OVER() AS board_total, SUM(CASE WHEN p.lack_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER() AS board_linked, SUM(CASE WHEN p.lack_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER() AS board_lack FROM t_veh_bind_page p
LEFT JOIN t_veh_ent e ON e.id = p.site_id AND e.del_flag = 0
p.del_flag = 0 AND p.node_no = #{nodeNo}
AND e.road_name LIKE CONCAT(#{roadPrefix}, '%')
AND p.bill_no LIKE CONCAT(#{billNo}, '%')
AND p.veh_code LIKE CONCAT(#{vehCode}, '%')
AND e.site_type LIKE CONCAT(#{siteType}, '%')
AND p.lack_count = 0
AND p.lack_count > 0
ORDER BY p.id DESC
